title: Playing with David Solero; the Jazz Festival
summary: Asked about playing with David Solero, who has left town; he will play the Jazz Festival.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: How long did you play with David Solero?
Oh I didn't know. Goodbye. When he left, after he left town then, after he left Moulady, I was playing right home.
He didn't leave town? I was looking for him a month back and I couldn't find him. You been going for a while now?
Yeah. Where did he go to? I don't know. I know who he stayed at. He lived right on the other side of John McAuthan.

He was on Royal Street. Royal Street. So, you're going to play at the Jazz Festival this year? Yeah, something's going to happen. You got your pin on. Maybe you'll meet somebody you know there. Right.
